ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_pairwise_reciprocal_gap_tanh_weighted
ir.intuition: Switch to a non-margin paradigm using a reciprocal inverse of the absolute advantage gap as a weighting factor combined with a tanh link on the difference of log probabilities, emphasizing smoothing and stable gradient flows particularly on smaller advantage gaps.
ir.pseudocode:
diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
weighting = 1 / (1 + abs(advantage_gap))
loss_terms = -logsigmoid(tanh(diff))
weighted_loss = weighting * loss_terms * weight
return mean(weighted_loss)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']
    weight = batch.get('weight', None)
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    tanh_diff = ops.tanh(diff)
    log_sigmoid_term = -ops.logsigmoid(tanh_diff)
    abs_adv_gap = ops.abs(adv_gap)
    weighting = ops.div(ops.ones_like(abs_adv_gap), ops.add(ops.ones_like(abs_adv_gap), abs_adv_gap))
    loss = ops.mul(weighting, log_sigmoid_term)
    if weight is not None:
        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)
    return ops.mean(loss)
